rules.interval: paired log ratios ln(C/B); n=12 -> one-based order statistics r(3), r(10); n=24 -> r(7), r(18) (analyze_bc_qualification.summarize_metric, unchanged)
rules.classification: PASS if upper <= ln(1+t); REGRESSION if lower > ln(1+t); else INCONCLUSIVE. For higher-is-better metrics the ratio is B/C. IMPROVED is reported (never claimed otherwise) only when the upper bound is below 0.
rules.A: v0.4.0 rules unchanged (analyze_bc_qualification.py --rules v0.4.0), one 12-pair extension per cell with an INCONCLUSIVE gated metric; INCONCLUSIVE_DISCLOSED only for an INCONCLUSIVE primary with median <= t and every supporting metric PASS; else UNRESOLVED
rules.B_C: v0.5.0 protocol sections 3-4 unchanged (tolerances 25/50/100/6%, B5 3.0x, C1-C4); lifecycle scope compact-bfs; window multipliers of run 4 (window-multipliers-dcd8ccc.json) reused unchanged so cells are identical to v0.5.0's; no extension, no rerun
rules.R: 12 analyzed pairs after 2 discarded warmup pairs, fresh process per observation, arm order balanced 6/6 within the analyzed pairs by a seeded shuffle (order seed 60500); no extension; tolerance primary 10%
rules.Rmem: deterministic allocator byte counts, one run per arm; REGRESSION if candidate > reference x 1.20, otherwise PASS; reported with absolute values
rules.M_desc: descriptive, no verdict; each configuration record classified VALID/INVALID by the validity rule; M5 rule (i) of the v0.6.0 design is re-evaluated descriptively (mean graph-lock wait of the batch job >= 50% of mean client latency for read95/read100 at 16 or 64 closed-loop clients without background activity)
rules.M_reg: 12 analyzed pairs after 2 warmup pairs, a fresh server process per observation, arm order balanced; throughput tolerance primary 10% (ratio B/C), client p99 tolerance query_tail 25%
rules.no_waiver_inheritance: No maintainer waiver or acceptance from v0.6.0 or earlier applies. Every v0.6.0 non-PASS cell (R HTTP import 60/30 REGRESSION, B4 import-high REGRESSION, C3 FAIL x3, A UNRESOLVED x2, INCONCLUSIVE(_DISCLOSED) cells, C4 disclosures) is re-measured under the same rules and reported as measured.
rules.validity: a configuration record is VALID only if errors == 0, item_errors is empty, noop_mutations == 0 and, with background activity, background.failures == 0 and background.completed > 0. 503 refusals are allowed and reported (admission limit 32 pending jobs). For M_reg every analyzed observation must also have only status 200 (unchanged analyzer). An invalid record is reported as invalid, never rerun or dropped; an M_reg cell with any invalid analyzed observation gets no verdict (INVALID).
rules.probe: contention-probe revision 2 (fixes of the v0.6.0 M supplement): KNOTREL_MAX_NODES = nodes + 100000, current ETag for imports, 503 feeder refusals retried after 10 ms and counted, per-item errors and no-op mutations counted, fresh extra-edge IDs per configuration

open_loop.rule: after M-desc, for each of M-standalone-{off,on}-100k config read95-b8-c16: offered rate = f x the closed-loop requests_per_s measured for that config in M-desc, f in {0.5, 0.9, 1.1}; 16 clients, 1 s warmup, 3 s measure, run on a fresh server of the same kind

M_desc.layout: v0.6.0 configurations unchanged; mixed50 configurations run on their own fresh server per kind, and each lifecycle50 configuration on its own fresh server (probe revision 2: lifecycle50 toggles base items and is meant for one configuration per server process)

M_reg.question: contention regression against published v0.6.0 on the v0.6.0 M_reg cells, probe revision 2

host_conditions.power: AC (pmset -g batt reports 'AC Power'); checked before every cell; a cell on battery invalidates the run
host_conditions.thermal: pmset -g therm recorded before every cell; any recorded thermal or performance warning invalidates the cell
host_conditions.concurrency: no cargo/rustc process and no other campaign; checked before each experiment
host_conditions.activity: no Antigravity IDE, Visual Studio Code or git process (scripts/host_activity_monitor.py --check) before every child; the continuous monitor samples the whole campaign

invalidation.code_change: any change to executed code of knotrel after freezing invalidates every experiment that ran that code; documentation-only commits do not (executed code identity is checked by comparing __TEXT,__text of release builds)
invalidation.tooling_change: any change to a probe, collector or analysis after freezing invalidates the affected experiment
invalidation.failed_child: a failing child stops the experiment; one rerun only for an infrastructure failure unrelated to the measured code, recorded with its cause
invalidation.invalid_runs: kept and reported; never deleted or overwritten (collectors refuse to overwrite)

resource_ceilings.memory: the host must keep at least 4 GiB free; probes report RSS
